market_rate_constant_note: Module 0 demo baseline. Fictional par of 4.875% chosen so the three canonical demo borrowers in backend/services/mock_data.py produce defensible, all-ITM spreads under default thresholds (min_spread_bps=75). Production deployments will source this from a rate-feed table. The mock_data `rate_spread_bps` fields (currently hardcoded 875/525/250) will be rewired by the next agent to derive from fn_rate_spread against this constant — expect the demo numbers to shift to 88/188/162.

cases.note: Par: current rate exactly equals market. Zero spread, no refi economic signal.
Clean positive: borrower 100 bps above market. Directional sanity case.
Negative spread: borrower already below market. No refi opportunity; downstream fn_in_the_money will evaluate FALSE against positive thresholds.
Large positive: 500 bps (5%) above market. Extreme but within realistic bounds for an old-vintage lien vs current offers. No overflow in INT.

Demo borrower B-48295 (Thompson). Raw (0.0650-0.04875)*10000 = 162.5 exact. Banker's rounding picks the EVEN neighbor -> 162, not 163. This is THE test that pins round-half-to-even vs. round-half-away-from-zero for fn_rate_spread.
NULL current rate -> 0. 'No signal == no opportunity.' Keeps downstream rate_spread_bps NOT NULL so fn_in_the_money's >= does not short-circuit.
NULL market rate -> 0. Same rationale; also guards against a missing rate-feed row in production.

Demo borrower B-48291 (Rodriguez). Raw (0.0575-0.04875)*10000 = 87.5 (IEEE754 noise pushes to 87.50000000000001). Rounds to 88. Preserves demo promise: B-48291 remains ITM at default min_spread_bps=75 (88 >= 75).
Demo borrower B-48294 (Park). Raw (0.0675-0.04875)*10000 = 187.5 (IEEE754 noise pushes to 187.50000000000003). Rounds to 188. B-48294 remains ITM at default min_spread_bps=75.
Exactly at the Module 0 default min_spread_bps threshold (75). Clean integer, no rounding ambiguity. Paired with in_the_money_golden.json boundary cases to pin the >= inclusive contract.
